title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.23
summary: Important compatibility update: current add-ons with BlackLanturn fixes and safer Standard updates.

sections.heading: Current tested add-ons and patches
bullets: Includes Umbrella 6.7.97 and TMDbHelper 6.18.2 with BlackLanturn playback, progress, cache and privacy fixes.
Current CocoScrapers, Skin Variables, InputStream Helper, InfoTagger and English language resources are included.

sections.heading: Update through BlackLanturn
bullets: Update BlackLanturn Installer, then install this build using Standard. Separate updates of patched add-ons are unnecessary.
Managed versions prevent ordinary upstream updates from silently replacing the patches. Future compatibility fixes arrive in BlackLanturn releases.

sections.heading: Keep your setup
bullets: Standard preserves selected settings and authorizations, local Kodi viewing databases and YouTube watch history. Clean and account-only reset deliberately use build defaults.
Newer compatible ordinary dependencies are kept as complete trees during Standard update. Unknown managed source stops before cleanup.

sections.heading: Playback and platform compatibility
bullets: Existing source selection, Play Next, language/subtitle defaults, automatic YouTube quality and platform-specific workarounds remain included.
Current Helper uses its watched-source setting for watched status and playback progress; the removed separate playback-source default is no longer written.
